prayerExcerpt.en-US: We ask that through their merits and prayers, in all things we may be defended by your protecting help.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Por seus méritos e preces concedei-nos sem cessar a vossa proteção.

meta.face: A lean old man of about seventy with a narrow, bony face — a broad, bony forehead, sharp, high cheekbones, a short, sharp, straight nose, small, very bright eyes set close together under bristling, upswept grey brows, a long, jutting chin under the beard and a thin mouth with a long upper lip; close-cropped silver hair, a long silver-grey beard divided into two points at the end, and a kind gaze. Not broad, not rounded, not heavy-set.
meta.basis: The images of Cletus show an old, bearded pope (Palma il Giovane, Venice, 1592-93; the statue at San Cleto, Rome); the forked beard is an artistic choice to keep him apart from the other white-bearded prelates.
